description: This Java source file defines the `ConnectivityCounterRegistry` class which manages and provides access to various connection metrics counters, supports initializing counters for connections, resetting them, aggregating metrics, and merging response data. It is part of a metrics monitoring system for connectivity services.

classes.name: ConnectivityCounterRegistry
classes.description: A final class that manages counters associated with connection metrics, providing methods to initialize, reset, retrieve, and merge metrics for connectivity monitoring.

methods.name: fromConfig
methods.description: Creates an instance of ConnectivityCounterRegistry from a given MonitoringCounterConfig object.

methods.name: initForConnection
methods.description: Initializes counters in the registry for a specific Connection object by setting up counters for its sources, targets, and responses address.

methods.name: resetForConnection
methods.description: Resets counters associated with the provided Connection object in the global counters map.

methods.name: getCounter
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a ConnectionMetricsCounter for specified connection id, metric type, direction, and address.

methods.name: forOutboundDispatched
methods.description: Returns counter for outbound dispatched messages for a specific connection and target.

methods.name: forOutboundAcknowledged
methods.description: Returns counter for outbound acknowledged messages for a specific connection and target.

methods.name: forOutboundFiltered
methods.description: Returns counter for outbound filtered messages for a specific connection and target.

methods.name: forOutboundPublished
methods.description: Returns counter for outbound published messages for a specific connection and target.

methods.name: forOutboundDropped
methods.description: Returns counter for outbound dropped messages for a specific connection and target.

methods.name: forInboundConsumed
methods.description: Returns counter for inbound consumed messages for a specific connection and source.

methods.name: forInboundAcknowledged
methods.description: Returns counter for inbound acknowledged messages for a specific connection and source.

methods.name: forInboundMapped
methods.description: Returns counter for inbound mapped messages for a specific connection and source.

methods.name: forInboundEnforced
methods.description: Returns counter for inbound enforced messages for a specific connection and source.

methods.name: forInboundDropped
methods.description: Returns counter for inbound dropped messages for a specific connection and source.

methods.name: forResponseDispatched
methods.description: Returns counter for response dispatched messages for a specific connection.

methods.name: forResponseDropped
methods.description: Returns counter for response dropped messages for a specific connection.

methods.name: forResponseMapped
methods.description: Returns counter for response mapped messages for a specific connection.

methods.name: forResponsePublished
methods.description: Returns counter for response published messages for a specific connection.

methods.name: forResponseAcknowledged
methods.description: Returns counter for response acknowledged messages for a specific connection.

methods.name: aggregateSourceMetrics
methods.description: Aggregates source metrics across counters for a given connection id.

methods.name: aggregateTargetMetrics
methods.description: Aggregates target metrics across counters for a given connection id.

methods.name: mergeRetrieveConnectionMetricsResponse
methods.description: Merges two RetrieveConnectionMetricsResponse objects into one, combining their metrics.

methods.name: aggregateConnectionMetrics
methods.description: Creates a combined ConnectionMetrics object from source and target metrics.

methods.name: mergeAddressMetric
methods.description: Merges two AddressMetric instances into a new one, combining measurements.

methods.name: mergeAddressMetricMap
methods.description: Merges two maps of AddressMetrics keyed by address, merging individual AddressMetrics.

methods.name: mergeAllMetrics
methods.description: Merges a collection of AddressMetrics into a single AddressMetric.

methods.name: mergeMeasurements
methods.description: Merges two measurements' count maps by summing their values.

methods.name: latest
methods.description: Determines the latest of two Instant objects, if both are not null.
